# TuneGrab

> Local-first YouTube music downloader: web UI, double-click launcher, and an agent API. Audio or video, playlists or singles, custom filenames, clean metadata.

## Run

- `start.bat` (Windows) or `python bridge/tunegrab_bridge.py serve --open`
- App: http://127.0.0.1:8787
- Requirements: Python 3.9+, yt-dlp, ffmpeg

## Agent entry points

- CLI: `python bridge/tunegrab_bridge.py add <URL> --mode audio --quality 320 --out <DIR> --json`
- Resolve only: `python bridge/tunegrab_bridge.py resolve <URL>`
- API: `POST /api/jobs`, `GET /api/status`, `GET /api/jobs/<id>/events`
- Docs: AGENTS.md, docs/API.md

## Rules

- Keep clean metadata and fixed file dates on unless the user says otherwise.
- Playlist cap is 200 by default, maximum 500.
- Only http(s) URLs.
- Never add tags beyond title and artist.

## Files

- index.html, assets/css/style.css, assets/js/app.js
- bridge/tunegrab_bridge.py
- README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/API.md
